row.body: The pencilled route to the house ends at an ammunition collection point; the key ring is tagged 'back before supper,' but no return time is entered.
row.title: No return time

sidecar.gloss: A household collection route has a departure and no recorded return.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field team could have logged a temporary equipment pickup and left its key behind; the note gives no reason for the route being blocked.

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
